Market mood is cautiously optimistic, driven by AI narrative and a surprisingly resilient jobs report, which is good for tech. 

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate (-45.46%) due to its leveraged nature and decay, especially on margin. SPAL is also a concern (-47.24%) for similar reasons. 

Watch: Keep an eye on the AI trade's sustainability and any follow-through from the jobs report. 

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching for clear signals in your core tech holdings.
plays: Trim SOXL: Consider reducing exposure given the significant loss and leveraged decay.
Trim SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate reducing this leveraged position.
Consider AVGO: Watch for entry near 424.68-424.26 if it pulls back, with a stop at 422.5.
